what: Evidence for the one dark-lever TODO left by the opendde size-ladder re-record
owner: NOT this merge. The SDPA_WIDE_K default flip is ed5d6074e (2026-09-19), which is not an ancestor of the previous baseline commit e69df58cb, and 11a92f686 does not mention the flag. The exemption reason is owed by the row that landed the flip.

counter_sites_read_from_source.served_above_cap_fused: SDPA_K_CHUNK_STATS[0] inside the `if o is not None` of the above-cap fused loop; increments together with SDPA_FUSED_LARGE_S_STATS[0]
counter_sites_read_from_source.served_wide_k_ladder: SDPA_K_CHUNK_STATS[0] inside the `if len(k_chunks) > 1` block, fused and stock branches
counter_sites_read_from_source.declined: SDPA_K_CHUNK_STATS[1] at the END of the `if len(k_chunks) > 1` block, so it cannot fire when _tri_att_k_chunks returns a single entry
counter_sites_read_from_source.fused_declined: SDPA_FUSED_LARGE_S_STATS[1] fires above the cap when no fused pair ran, and does NOT touch SDPA_K_CHUNK_STATS

dead_end_recorded_so_it_is_not_repeated: Two q_len models were tested against the six observed rungs and BOTH were refuted, so the reason must not be written from either. (a) q_len = residue count: _tri_att_k_chunks returns a single entry at all six rungs (shipped k 256/256/160/256/224/256, every one dividing the padded length), which cannot produce the observed 8 and 56 serves. (b) q_len = 2N, suggested by the 512 aa census reject key (1024, 12, 1024, 32): reproduces five rungs but not 768, where len(k_chunks) is 1 at q_len 1536 yet SDPA_K_CHUNK_STATS[1] reads 8. The declined counter sits inside the len>1 block, so either the real q_len at the 768 rung is not 1536, or more than one distinct shape is presented per fold.
how_to_settle_it: The counters live in the SPAWNED predict worker, not the parent, so an in-process runpy wrapper reads zeros (in-process-patch-never-reaches-a-spawn-child). Use the census path the size-ladder arm itself uses and dump SDPA_CHUNK_PICKS, which is keyed by the real (q_len, k_len) actually presented.
